pick.headline: Macedonia admitted to the United Nations under a provisional name
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of April 9, 1993, carried a Macedonian address declaring that the republic, "now, as an equal member" of the United Nations, would uphold the UN Charter.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: East Europe, No. 067, 9 April 1993
